protocol.name: cardplay-long-sl-holdout-v1
protocol.candidate: 50,000-step SL checkpoint selected by validation NLL before this experiment
protocol.selection: No model selection or retraining based on these holdout results
protocol.test_exclusion: All existing cardplay splits, bidding training/validation splits, bidding board libraries and historical evaluation board IDs
protocol.inference: Greedy neural; paired rooms; same recorded auction and actual 52-card play
protocol.gate: Continue to training-seed replication only if both primary 97.5% board-bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero (Bonferroni-style correction for two primary comparisons)
protocol.if_gate_passes: Replicate two additional training seeds with the same 52,928 update budget, learning rate and validation-only checkpoint selection; confirm on a separate fresh holdout before search comparison
protocol.if_gate_fails: Do not expand PPO or automatically train replicas; analyse imitation targets, seed sensitivity and validation-versus-play gap

decision: Replicate two additional training seeds with the same 52,928 update budget, learning rate and validation-only checkpoint selection; confirm on a separate fresh holdout before search comparison
limits: One trained candidate seed; board intervals do not measure training-seed uncertainty
